Alternative pathway task, fixtures and matching key

1. Loan history and category joins

Suggested time: 2 minutes

Instructional strategy: Learning intention

Use the separate database-project.sqlite edition of the equipment desk. ReplacementCost contains fictional whole-dollar teaching estimates, not current prices. Activities are ungraded. This week practices joins and summaries; controlled changes follow in Week 6. Teaching source: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#database-solution.

2. A third key match

Suggested time: 5 minutes

Instructional strategy: Recall and prediction

Category supplies CategoryName through CategoryID. Recall the Loan to Equipment match first, then Equipment to Category. Category belongs to the item, not directly to a borrower. Teaching source: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#database-solution.

3. A category history query

Suggested time: 6 minutes

Instructional strategy: Worked example

The complete report has six rows: L001/E01/Imaging; L002/E02/Support; L003/E03/Audio; L004/E04/Imaging; L005/E02/Support; L006/E05/Audio. There is no Returned filter, so both active and returned history appears. Teaching source: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#database-solution.

4. A history extract to inspect

Suggested time: 10 minutes

Instructional strategy: Teacher model with predictions

This is an extract from the six-row report, not the whole result. L002 and L005 both refer to E02 but represent different events and statuses. A one-to-many join can legitimately repeat an item’s values. Learners should preserve both history rows. Teaching source: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#database-solution.

5. Three questions for a join

Suggested time: 10 minutes

Instructional strategy: Guided paired practice

ON must match Loan.EquipmentID to Equipment.EquipmentID and Equipment.CategoryID to Category.CategoryID. Result grain is a loan event. INNER JOIN omits rows lacking a match. Correct required FKs protect the supplied relationships when enforced. The join does not automatically report parent rows with no child events. Teaching source: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#database-solution.

6. A readable history report

Suggested time: 12 minutes

Instructional strategy: Independent application

L003 links to B001 Learner A, E03 Recorder and C03 Audio. Compare all six rows in the worked report file. E01 and E04 share Camera as a description, so descriptions cannot uniquely identify an item. Missing ON conditions can combine unrelated rows. Repair the key match rather than adding DISTINCT to hide a problem. Teaching source: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#database-solution.

7. An unused borrower

Suggested time: 5 minutes

Instructional strategy: Misconception check with reasons

No. With no matching Loan row, the borrower has no result row. This can be reasoned through without inserting data this week. A report including every borrower, even with zero loans, requires a different query design. Do not invent a loan to make the borrower appear. Teaching source: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#database-solution.

8. A suspicious row count

Suggested time: 5 minutes

Instructional strategy: Reflection and a fresh example

Inspect missing or incorrect ON conditions and non-unique description matches. For the supplied six loans, unique referenced item/category keys give one matching item and category per loan. Repeated IDs across legitimate loan events are expected; unrelated combinations are not. Teaching source: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#database-solution.
